question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for customizing prompt text and startup-turn behavior after bare `/new` or `/reset`?
rationale: The request adds a new compatibility-sensitive config surface across session state, reset command handling, bootstrap-aware prompts, startup context, and related greeting/model policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, acknowledgement-only versus startup-turn behavior, bootstrap safeguards, future greeting/model controls, schema, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving current acknowledgement defaults and documenting exactly when the text is used.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep the hardcoded prompt for now and route customization into the broader reset greeting/model policy discussion first.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, acknowledgement-only versus startup-turn behavior, bootstrap safeguards, future greeting/model controls, schema, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shipped acknowledgement branch, reset command contract, and config compatibility surface most directly tied to steipete's recent reset-command work.
